entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Thanks for coming.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...There's actually something I wanted[n]to talk to you about.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I know this is a little personal, but...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You remember how my former[n]girlfriend came up the other day?[n]Rumi?
entries.uk: Пам'ятаєш, нещодавно згадували[n]мою колишню дівчину? Румі?

entries.en: Yeah.
Kind of.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: We were even engaged, if you can[n]believe that.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: She was so cheerful. I mean, she could get[n]pretty aggressive—she was always kind of[n]hot-headed—but always so kind, too.
entries.uk: Вона була така життєрадісна. Тобто могла[n]бути доволі запальною — завжди трохи[n]гарячою, — але й завжди такою доброю.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...She was the best thing that ever[n]happened to me.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I didn't deserve her, but... if we'd had[n]our shot, my life would've been so much[n]happier than it had ever been.
entries.uk: Я її не заслуговував, але... якби в нас[n]був шанс, моє життя було б набагато[n]щасливішим, ніж будь-коли.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But reality's never that simple.
entries.uk: Але реальність ніколи не буває такою[n]простою.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...A burglar broke into her family's home.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Rumi and I had been visiting. We were[n]there to see what he'd done to them.[n]It was... just bad luck.
entries.uk: Ми з Румі якраз були в гостях. І побачили,[n]що він із ними зробив. Нам просто...[n]не пощастило.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But it didn't end there. He must have[n]been desperate to escape... He attacked[n]Rumi on his way out.
entries.uk: Але на цьому все не скінчилося. Мабуть,[n]він відчайдушно хотів утекти... Тікаючи,[n]він напав на Румі.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I was right there with her, and... I couldn't[n]do anything. Haha... Pathetic, right?
entries.uk: Я був поруч із нею і... нічого не зміг[n]удіяти. Ха-ха... Жалюгідно, правда?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: We were lucky Rumi's injuries weren't[n]more severe. Her physical ones, at least.
entries.uk: Нам пощастило, що поранення Румі[n]були не тяжчі. Принаймні фізичні.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But the shock of the incident was too[n]much. She had a mental breakdown.
entries.uk: Але шок від того випадку був надто[n]сильним. У неї стався нервовий зрив.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...We talked about that, didn't we?[n]How wounds of the heart aren't as[n]straightforward as physical ones?
entries.uk: ...Ми ж говорили про це, пам'ятаєш?[n]Що душевні рани не такі прості,[n]як фізичні?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: She never really recovered from what[n]happened. Even after all this time.
entries.uk: Вона так і не оговталася від того, що[n]сталося. Навіть після стількох років.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I... kind of lost myself in that pain[n]for a while, too.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: She didn't deserve that... None of them[n]did. None of them did anything wrong!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...Sorry.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...When I saw her in that hospital bed,[n]I made a vow.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I swore that I'd do all I could to fight[n]back against the unfairness of reality.[n]If someone suffered like that, I'd help.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...Like I said before... Rumi's in a better[n]mental place now. She's happy.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But that pain I felt back then—that's how[n]this project was born.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And thanks to you, I've finally found[n]the true goal of that research, too.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I don't care how long it takes me. I will[n]make my dream come true.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: For Rumi's sake, of course... but for you[n]too, [lName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I... honestly don't have the words to say[n]what all this means to me. But I can at[n]least say this.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Thank you... so much. For everything.[n]Thanks to you, I found my answer.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And once it's ready... I hope you'll let me[n]use it to help you find the happiness[n]you deserve.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: My path is clear now.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I think this'll probably be the last time[n]I come to you about the paper.
Kind of sad...[clr 27]
Is our deal over?
Well... take care of yourself.
